blurb: Nestled in the heart of downtown Augusta, Sugar Magnolias is a timeless, Southern gem, boutique event venue, offering an elegant space for your most cherished moments. Housed in a beautifully restored Victorian home built in 1871, our venue blends historic charm with modern-day romance.
